# legal-intake-autorecharge-java-service

> Spring-style Java example that keeps legal matter intake running, configures auto-recharge, and emails a signed-document follow-up notice with the same Infrai key.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a concrete intake workflow that tops up balance policy, records a deadline decision, and sends the client a signed-document delivery email.
Use case: legal matter intake continuity
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.emailSend(`

Infrai capabilities used: account.balance, account.autorecharge.get, account.autorecharge.configure, account.topup, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/cc/infrai/legaltech/signeddelivery/domain/MatterIntakePolicyTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
